# All-Star Renovations

> All-Star Renovations is a remodeling contractor founded in 2014 and headquartered at 11 Arnett Ln, Conway, AR 72032. Services: bathroom remodeling (primary), kitchen remodeling (secondary) and handyman services (third). Phone: (501) 504-3398. Email: info@allstarreno.com. Serving a 50-mile radius of Conway, including Faulkner, Pulaski, Saline and Lonoke counties and North Little Rock.

## Naming
- Legal business name: All-Star Renovations
- Also known as: All-Star Renovate (Google Business Profile short name), allstarreno (online handle)
- All-Star Shower Systems is our branded shower service (walk-in showers and tub-to-shower conversions), not a separate company.

## Business facts
- Founder: Thomas Pedersen; in business since 2014; 20 years of experience
- 500+ completed bathroom remodels
- Fully Insured · Workers’ Comp Covered · Certified Pros
- Warranty: lifetime product warranty on All-Star Shower Systems materials; 5-year workmanship warranty
- 100% Customer Guarantee
- Address: 11 Arnett Ln, Conway, AR 72032
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7:30 AM–5:00 PM; Saturday 7:00 AM–7:00 PM; Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM (Central Time)
- Financing available through Acorn Finance, HFS Financial and RenoFi
- Bio directory: https://allstarreno.link
